title: Exp52 is a conditional ratio bound, not measured runtime
statement: For the stated formulas and geometric/source interfaces, directed Fraction/Decimal arithmetic gives normalized quadratic resistance/exp6267<=.5742731505, hence conditional C/ZA>exp(-6267) and W_cut/C<exp52 with the corrected cut. The cubic decoder gives exp57. The sharper reviewed2d(d+1) multiplicity is not used. Earlier narrative saying the scalar is uncertified is superseded only for arithmetic, not general geometry. Exp52 remains enormous and is not an implemented estimator, uniform polynomial theorem or measured time.
